jobs.title: Senior Sales Manager - Power & Utilities
jobs.description:
ANYbotics is a fast-growing tech company dedicated to shaping the future of mobile robotics across multiple industries. Join our highly talented and motivated team of more than 190 people and work on cutting-edge robot technology.


Power demand in the US is surging with data centres and electrification, and the grid is entering an investment supercycle. After successful deployments in power generation and transmission, ANYbotics is building its US Power & Utilities business, and we are looking for the person to own it
This is a hands-on market-building role: you will take autonomous inspection from first deployments to fleet-scale adoption across US power and utilities.
You will work with stakeholders from plant operations, reliability and engineering through to procurement and executive leadership. Success will depend on your ability to understand industrial customer needs, build a strong operational and financial case for autonomous inspection and manage complex sales cycles through to close.
The role reports directly to our Sr Director Sales for Power & Utilities, and works closely with Solution Architects, Business Value Consultants, Customer Success, and Product.

Market & Technology
ANYbotics is pioneering autonomous robotic platforms for inspection and operations in challenging industrial environments.

Our ANYmal robots move autonomously through facilities, collect inspection data and help customers monitor high-voltage assets, substations, and generation equipment without exposing people to hazardous, repetitive or difficult work. The platform combines robotics, autonomy, inspection payloads, software, analytics and integrations into an end-to-end industrial solution.

Across power and utilities, customers face persistent challenges around safety, asset reliability, workforce availability and unplanned outages. The commercial opportunity is to help operators identify valuable applications, prove impact at site level and expand successful deployments across their wider organisation.
About Us
ANYbotics is a leading robotics company specialising in advanced autonomous systems. With a successful Series B financing round closed and strong momentum in the market, we are entering an important phase of international growth.

Our mission is to transform industrial inspection and operations through world-class robotics. We combine deep technical expertise with real customer deployments across energy, chemicals, utilities, metals and other industrial sectors.

This is an opportunity to join at a stage where the technology is proven, customer interest is strong and the US market offers significant room to grow.
Your Contributions
-
Build and execute the US commercial strategy across power generation, grid infrastructure, and utilities

-
Develop strategic enterprise opportunities through direct prospecting, industry relationships, partners and customer networks

-
Own complex sales cycles from discovery and business-case development through technical evaluation, negotiation and close

-
Build trusted relationships across plant, engineering, reliability, procurement and executive stakeholders

-
Translate autonomous inspection into clear outcomes around safety, reliability, productivity and operational risk

-
Turn successful initial deployments into broader multi-site and enterprise agreements

-
Coordinate closely with internal technical and commercial teams, while maintaining strong account planning, forecasting and pipeline discipline

-
Represent ANYbotics in the market and bring customer, competitor and industry insight back into the organisation
Your Profile
-
Proven enterprise sales or business-development success in power generation, electric utilities, grid infrastructure, or a closely related industrial market

-
Current or recent experience selling a complex software, hardware or integrated technology solution, ideally involving automation, robotics, asset reliability, industrial AI or digitalisation

-
Strong track record creating new opportunities, navigating complex customer organisations and closing significant multi-stakeholder deals

-
Commercial judgement to connect technical capability with clear outcomes around safety, reliability, productivity and financial value

-
Credibility with both technical users and senior decision-makers, including experience expanding initial projects into larger strategic accounts

-
Independent, disciplined working style, with the ability to own a US market while collaborating closely with international technical and commercial teams

-
Willingness to travel regularly across the United States
Bonus Points
-
Existing relationships across relevant US power and utility operators

-
Experience selling robotics, autonomous systems, substation monitoring, industrial inspection, condition monitoring or predictive-maintenance solutions

-
Technical or engineering background, or experience selling integrated hardware, software and recurring services
We offer you a very exciting and dynamic work environment, the opportunity to become part of a fast-growing company and an ambitious team that is on a mission to change the industrial inspection market, a chance to leverage your experience and bring in your own ideas to grow our presence and build trust with our customers in North America
 
 
 
Agency Policy: We are not currently partnering with external search firms or recruitment agencies. Any profiles or resumes submitted to ANYbotics employees without a prior written agreement will be considered public disclosure and the property of ANYbotics, involving no liability or fee for subsequent hiring.

jobs.title: VP Sales, North America
jobs.description:
ANYbotics is a fast-growing tech company dedicated to shaping the future of mobile robotics across multiple industries. Join our highly talented and motivated team of more than 190 people and work on cutting-edge robot technology.


ANYbotics develops autonomous inspection robots that help industrial companies improve safety, asset reliability and operational performance. Our robot, ANYmal, combines advanced mobility, AI-driven autonomy and industrial sensing to inspect complex facilities in demanding environments.
With robots already deployed at leading industrial organisations around the world, we are looking for a VP Sales, North America to lead our next phase of commercial growth across the US and Canada.

The Opportunity
Reporting directly to our CRO, you will own the North American sales strategy, regional target and sales organisation.

You will lead and grow an initially small team, win new strategic customers and expand successful site-level deployments into multi-site, fleet and enterprise-wide adoption. This is a hands-on leadership role, combining regional ownership with direct involvement in our most important customer relationships, deal strategies and negotiations.

Working closely with Solution Architecture, Business Value Consulting, Customer Success and Product, you will build a repeatable enterprise sales approach across our core industrial markets.
Your Contributions
-
Own and execute the North American commercial strategy across the US and Canada, translating our global ambitions into clear regional, industry and strategic account priorities.

-
Lead and grow the North American sales organisation , hiring, developing and coaching the team to deliver sustained growth.

-
Own the regional sales target and commercial operating rhythm , driving strong discipline across pipeline development, forecasting, account planning and execution.

-
Accelerate enterprise adoption within strategic accounts , converting successful pilots and site-level deployments into multi-site, fleet and enterprise-wide agreements.

-
Win new strategic customers through direct prospecting, industry relationships, partnerships and disciplined enterprise business development.

-
Stay personally involved in our most important opportunities , leading deal strategy, executive engagement, business-value selling, negotiation and closing.

-
Partner closely across Solution Architecture, Business Value Consulting, Customer Success and Product to deliver strong customer outcomes, support successful deployments and feed market insight back into the business.
Your Profile
-
A proven sales leadership track record in industrial technology , with a background in industrial automation, robotics, Industrial IoT, Industrial AI, asset performance management, predictive maintenance or inspection technology.

-
Substantial experience selling to North American customers in at least one of our core markets: Power & Utilities, Oil & Gas, Chemicals, Metals & Minerals, cement or pulp & paper.

-
Demonstrated people leadership and commercial delivery , including hiring, coaching and developing sales teams, owning a regional or business-unit sales target, and delivering growth.

-
A genuinely hands-on leadership style , with continued personal involvement in strategic customers, major opportunities, negotiation and closing.

-
A strong record in complex, long-cycle enterprise sales , building quantified business cases and aligning operational, technical, procurement and executive stakeholders.

-
Demonstrated success expanding initial deployments into multi-site or enterprise relationships , with an understanding of the operational and commercial requirements for scaling adoption.

-
Strong commercial judgement and operating discipline , including sales strategy, pipeline development, forecasting and strategic account planning.
Bonus Points
-
Experience selling solutions that combine hardware, software, services and operational deployment .

-
An established network of industrial customers and strategic partners in North America .

-
Experience building a sales organisation in a scale-up or emerging industrial technology category .
We offer you a very exciting and dynamic work environment, the opportunity to become part of a fast-growing company and an ambitious team that is on a mission to change the industrial inspection market, a chance to leverage your experience and bring in your own ideas to grow our presence and build trust with our customers in North America
